title: 第十二章破境
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
废阁门前。

    正午的阳光穿透翻滚的毒瘴，变成惨淡的黄绿色，落在碎木屑上。

    叶凡站在门槛边，双手抱在胸前，静静的看着马得水一行人消失在山道拐角。

    周遭空气里还残留着几分紧张。

    叶凡脸上的惶恐和茫然早已消失的干干净净。

    他回想着刚才马得水的反应。

    震惊，质问，再探查修为后的惊疑不定，突然认怂跑路。

    这胖子的情绪变化太明显了。

    叶凡摸了摸下巴。刚才装的还挺累，不过这胖子还真好骗。算了，管他好不好骗。

    “奇果的借口太烂，他根本没信。”

    “但他探查完我的修为后，反而吓退了。”

    叶凡脑子转的极快。

    两个锻体六阶失踪，自己只有锻体一阶。

    马得水这种老油条，绝对不会认为是自己反杀了那两人。

    他一定会往更高层去想。

    比如，有人暗中保护。

    在这天剑宗里，能让马得水联想到会保护自己的人，除了柳菡烟，找不出第二个。

    叶凡忍不住笑了一声。

    “这肥猪，自己把自己吓破了胆。”

    笑意只在脸上停留了片刻，便迅速收敛。

    叶凡太了解马得水这种底层管事了。

    欺软怕硬，贪婪阴毒。

    这种人一旦发现自己惹不起目标，绝对不会就此罢休，而是会想尽办法把水搅浑，让更强的人来出头。

    马得水刚才临走时，虽然极力掩饰，但眼底那股子算计和阴冷，根本藏不住。

    叶凡转过身，看着屋内破败的陈设，双眼微微眯起，声音在屋子里显得格外清晰。

    “这肥猪怂了，但他那眼神……是要借内门那些疯狗的刀来咬我啊。”

    叶凡关上门，把踹烂的门板重新架回去。

    木门已经合不上了。

    他也懒的修，找根烂木头顶住，转身回到桌前。

    桌上干干净净。

    丹药、功法、合成炉，都被他收起来。

    可屋里那股麻烦味儿还没散。

    马得水临走前那架势，叶凡越想越觉得不对劲。

    怂，是真怂，怕，也是真怕。

    但这种人怕完之后，绝不会老实。

    叶凡活了九十年，在杂役堆里见过太多这种货色。

    平日里谁弱踩谁，真碰上硬茬立刻缩头，可一转身，他能把你祖宗十八代都扯进来，借别人的手再咬你一口。

    马得水就是这路货。

    “自己不敢动手，就去喊人啊？”

    叶凡坐下，手指在桌面敲两下。

    “还得喊那种最容易上头的人。”

    内门，柳菡烟，追求者。

    这几个玩意串起来，麻烦可就大了。

    叶凡现在表面只有锻体三阶。

    可内门那些人不会讲道理。

    他们只会觉得，快入土的老杂役，凭什么跟柳菡烟扯上关系？

    更要命的是，马得水多半会往外添油加醋。

    什么旧情未了，什么暗中保护，什么返老还童。

    这些话传出去，信的人未必多，但听着不舒服的人肯定不少。

    对内门弟子来说，杀个刚入外门的老杂役，不需要证据，也不需要理由。
content_en:
In front of the abandoned pavilion.

    The midday sun penetrated the rolling poisonous miasma and turned into a pale yellow-green color, falling on the broken wood chips.

    Ye Fan stood at the threshold, holding his hands on his chest, quietly watching Ma Deshui and his party disappear at the corner of the mountain road.

    There was still some tension in the air around him.

    The panic and confusion on Ye Fan's face had long since disappeared.

    He thought back to Ma Deshui's reaction just now.

    Shocked, questioned, and confused after further probing his cultivation level, he suddenly gave up and ran away.

    The fat man's emotional changes were too obvious.

    Ye Fan touched his chin. I was quite tired just pretending, but this fat man is really easy to fool. Forget it, it doesn’t matter whether he is a good liar or not.

    "Qi Guo's excuse is so lame, he doesn't believe it at all."

    "But after he explored my cultivation level, he got scared."

    Ye Fan's mind was spinning very fast.

    Two of the sixth-level body forgings are missing, and I only have the first level of body forging.

    An old man like Ma Deshui would never think that he had killed those two people.

    He will definitely think about it at a higher level.

    For example, someone is secretly protecting you.

    In this Tianjian Sect, apart from Liu Hanyan, there was no other person that Ma Deshui could think of as someone who would protect him.

    Ye Fan couldn't help laughing.

    "This fat pig scared himself out of his wits."

    The smile only stayed on his face for a moment, then quickly faded away.

    Ye Fan knows low-level managers like Ma Deshui very well.

    Bullying the weak and fearing the strong, greedy and vicious.

    Once this kind of person finds that he cannot offend his target, he will never give up. Instead, he will try his best to muddy the water and let stronger people take the lead.

    When Ma Deshui left just now, although he tried his best to hide it, he couldn't hide the calculating and cold look in his eyes.

    Ye Fan turned around and looked at the dilapidated furnishings in the room, his eyes narrowed slightly, and his voice sounded particularly clear in the room.

    "This fat pig is scared, but the look in his eyes... wants to use the knives of those mad dogs in the inner door to bite me."

    Ye Fan closed the door and put the broken door panel back together.

    The wooden door can no longer be closed.

    He was too lazy to fix it, so he found a piece of rotten wood to hold it against, and turned back to the table.

    The table is clean.

    The elixirs, techniques, and synthesis furnaces were all put away by him.

    But the smell of trouble still lingered in the house.

    The more Ye Fan thought about Ma Deshui's posture before leaving, the more he felt something was wrong.

    If you are timid, you are really timid, and if you are afraid, you are really scared.

    But after this kind of person is afraid, he will never be honest.

    Ye Fan has lived for ninety years and has seen too many such things among the handymen.

    Normally, he would step on anyone who is weak, and immediately shrink back when he encounters a tough fight, but when he turns around, he can drag in eighteen generations of your ancestors and bite you again with someone else's hand.

    Ma Deshui is this kind of guy.

    "You don't dare to take action yourself, so why don't you go call someone?"

    Ye Fan sat down and tapped his fingers on the table twice.

    "You have to call the kind of person who is easiest to offend."

    Inner door, Liu Hanyan, pursuer.

    If these things are put together, the trouble will be big.

    Ye Fan currently only has the third level of physical training.

    But those people in the inner sect can't be reasonable.

    They will only think that the old handyman who is about to die is related to Liu Hanyan.

    What's even worse is that Ma Deshui will probably add fuel to the fire.

    What old love remains, what secret protection, what rejuvenation.

    When these words spread, not many people may believe them, but there must be many people who feel uncomfortable hearing them.

    For inner sect disciples, there is no need for evidence or reason to kill an old handyman who has just joined the outer sect.
